listitem.para: MariaDB is upgraded to the latest stable LTS release with each Service Pack (10.6 in SP4/SP5, 10.11 in SP6, 11.8 LTS in SP7). Older Service Packs receive security backports. MariaDB 11.8 LTS is supported until SP7 LTSS ends (December 2034).

Each Service Pack provides the latest PostgreSQL major version as default in the Basesystem Module (PostgreSQL 14 in SP4, 15 in SP5, 16 in SP6, 17 in SP7). Older default versions move to the Legacy Module in the subsequent Service Pack, receiving minor updates until upstream EOL.

Redis was shipped up to &suselinux; 15 SP6 (Redis 6.2 in SP4/SP5, 7.2 in SP6). Redis is removed starting in SP7 and replaced with Valkey 8.0.x (which is downward-compatible). Valkey minor versions can be updated in &suselinux; 15 SP7.
